title: 第22章 院子第23章 战贴
content_zh:
在场众人闻言，顿时露出喜色，这一次收获的宝肉，足以让在场明劲武人提升一两个小境界，也能让学徒突破明劲的概率提升一大截。
随着沈衡的交代，在场众人把这批资源分了干净。
陆沉旁观着一切，眉心不由微微一动，这黑鳞狼的心脏至少价值八十两一个，沈衡一次性拿出这么多，算是下了血本了。
毕竟在场众人中，能买得起黑鳞狼心脏的不多，一旦突破失败怕是根本还不起。
等这批黑鳞狼心脏被拿走，陆沉被单独留了下来。
只见沈师看着他询问道：“我看你铁甲功练得登堂入室，要不要留在武馆中任教？”
陆沉愣了一下，但又很快反应了过来。
沈衡已经很少亲自传授武学，新收的学徒大多数都是他们这些入室弟子授课。
以前是七个弟子轮流指点，这次负责授课的七个师兄中一死一伤，人员缺额得要补上才行。
考虑到指点他人修炼对自己也有好处，陆沉就直接道：“既然师尊不弃，弟子每七天可抽出半日来武馆授课。”
沈衡平静道：“好，那每月给你加三两银子的俸禄。”
“多谢师傅。”
陆沉躬身行礼，这笔钱虽然不多，但蚊子再小也是肉。
……
“清静雅致，确实不错。”
吃过午饭，韩枫就带着陆沉来看房子。
这是一间雅致的院子，分为前后两院，前院空间却不小，种着两棵枇杷树，正屋有五间房，各种家具设施一应俱全。
而后院的墙高高垒起，不容易被人窥伺，非常适合用来练武。
陆沉对这间房子很满意，不由开口问道：“月租多少钱？”
“您看您说的什么话？”

韩枫连忙摇头，摆手道：“我们是师兄弟，这点钱何必计较？”
“而且这间房子本就空了很久，反正也是空着，若是师兄不嫌弃，那小院就给您先住着。”
陆沉眉头微挑，但还是摇头道：“一码归一码，该付的钱不会少你。”
双方一阵客套，最后陆沉用每年五两银子的价格租下了这栋院落。
租完院子，陆沉又跟着韩枫去了一趟韩家商铺，跟韩家掌柜敲定了挂靠的事情。
……
处理完琐事，陆沉没有急着回家。
他一路往外城而去，最后在棚户区找到了一户人家。
此时，屋内灯火通明，一个老妇人正抱着一个幼童，满脸都是哀愁之色。
“许川不在？”
陆沉走进屋里，眉心微挑的问道。
那老妇人有些警惕，不由看向陆沉问道：“您是？”
“我找他有事。”陆沉平静道。
那老妇人摇了摇头，然后开口说道：“你可是沈氏武馆的高足？”
“我们家许川参加春狩，到现在也还没有回来，不知道是不是出了什么事。”
陆沉眉心微皱，许川当初推了他一把，自然不敢回到沈氏武馆的。
许川现在连家都不敢回，恐怕是担心被沈师知道后找他秋后算账。
content_en:
When everyone present heard this, they immediately showed joy. The treasure meat harvested this time was enough to improve the Ming Jin warriors present by one or two small realms, and also increased the apprentice's probability of breaking through Ming Jin by a large margin.
Following Shen Heng's explanation, everyone present divided the resources.
Lu Chen watched everything, his eyebrows twitching slightly. The heart of the black-scaled wolf was worth at least eighty taels. Shen Heng paid so much in one go, which was considered a huge investment.
After all, not many of the people present could afford the heart of the Black Scaled Wolf, and if the breakthrough failed, they might not be able to afford it at all.
After the black-scaled wolf hearts were taken away, Lu Chen was left alone.
I saw Master Shen looking at him and asking: "I see that you have mastered the Iron Armor Kung Fu so well that you can enter the martial arts hall. Do you want to stay in the martial arts gym and teach?"
Lu Chen was stunned for a moment, but he quickly reacted.
Shen Heng rarely teaches martial arts in person anymore, and most of the new apprentices are taught by his disciples.
In the past, seven disciples took turns giving guidance. This time, one of the seven senior brothers responsible for teaching was killed and one was injured. The vacancy had to be filled.
Considering that instructing others to practice would also be beneficial to him, Lu Chen said directly: "Since the master will not give up, the disciple can spare half a day every seven days to come to the martial arts hall to teach."
Shen Heng said calmly: "Okay, I will give you an additional salary of three taels of silver every month."
"Thank you, master."
Lu Chen bowed and saluted. Although the money was not much, mosquitoes were still meat no matter how small they were.
…
“Quiet and elegant, really nice.”
After lunch, Han Feng took Lu Chen to look at the house.
This is an elegant courtyard, divided into front and rear courtyards. The front courtyard is quite spacious, with two loquat trees planted there. There are five rooms in the main house, and all kinds of furniture and facilities are available.
The wall in the backyard is high, making it difficult for people to spy on it, making it very suitable for martial arts training.
Lu Chen was very satisfied with this house and couldn't help but ask: "How much is the monthly rent?"
"What do you think you said?"
Han Feng shook his head quickly and waved his hand: "We are brothers, why bother about this little money?"
"And this house has been empty for a long time. It is empty anyway. If senior brother doesn't mind it, I will let you live in the small courtyard first."
Lu Chen raised his brows slightly, but still shook his head and said: "One code is one code, and you will not be short of what you should pay."
The two parties were polite for a while, and finally Lu Chen rented the courtyard for five taels of silver per year.
After renting the yard, Lu Chen followed Han Feng to the Han family shop and finalized the affiliation with the Han family shopkeeper.
…
After handling the trivial matters, Lu Chen was not in a hurry to go home.
He headed all the way to the outer city, and finally found a family in a shanty town.
At this time, the house was brightly lit, and an old woman was holding a young child, with a sad look on her face.
"Xu Chuan isn't here?"
Lu Chen walked into the room and asked with a slightly raised eyebrow.
The old woman was a little wary and couldn't help but look at Lu Chen and asked, "Who are you?"
"I have something to do with him." Lu Chen said calmly.
The old woman shook her head, and then said, "Are you a disciple of the Shen Family Martial Arts School?"
"Our family Xu Chuan participated in the Spring Hunting and has not returned yet. I don't know if something happened."
Lu Chen frowned slightly. Xu Chuan had pushed him, so naturally he didn't dare to return to Shen's martial arts gym.
Xu Chuan doesn't even dare to go home now, probably because he is worried that Master Shen will find out about it and settle the score with him.
